+"""Generate the fixed-instance place_can_basket trajectory.
+
+Run: python /app/output/gen.py
+The right arm places the can; the left arm lifts and holds the basket.
+"""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from rcb_traj import Session
+
+
+OUTPUT = Path('/app/output/trajectory.npz')
+
+
+def generate():
+    s = Session('place_can_basket', instance='/app/instance.json')
+    env = s.env
+    from envs.utils import ArmTag
+
+    right, left = ArmTag('right'), ArmTag('left')
+
+    def move(action):
+        if not env.move(action):
+            raise RuntimeError('Motion planning failed')
+
+    def hold(steps):
+        for _ in range(steps):
+            s.step()
+
+    s.record_start()
+
+    # Fixed can grasp, with the gripper approaching vertically.
+    pre = [.224114888, .049733739, 1.013538465,
+           .279944837, -.64934504, .27952358, .64949864]
+    grasp = pre.copy()
+    grasp[2] -= .08
+    move(env.move_to_pose(right, pre))
+    move(env.move_to_pose(right, grasp))
+    move(env.close_gripper(right))
+    move(env.move_by_displacement(right, z=.10))
+    move(env.move_by_displacement(right, y=-.20))
+
+    # Turn in free space, then cross above the front compartment in short
+    # segments to prevent a long joint-space path from dipping into the rim.
+    can_p = env.can.get_pose().p
+    target = env.get_place_pose(
+        env.can, right,
+        [float(can_p[0]), float(can_p[1]), .885, 1, 0, 0, 0],
+        constrain='align', align_axis=[.7071, -.7071, 0], pre_dis=0,
+    )
+    move(env.move_to_pose(right, target))
+    for _ in range(10):
+        move(env.move_by_displacement(right, x=-.024))
+    move(env.move_by_displacement(right, x=-.015, y=.008, z=-.03))
+    move(env.open_gripper(right))
+    hold(300)
+
+    # Clear the handle before bringing in the other arm.
+    for _ in range(7):
+        move(env.move_by_displacement(right, x=.03))
+    move(env.back_to_origin(right))
+
+    basket_pre = [-.02006, -.076814, 1.054128,
+                  .70718, .000127, .707033, -.000125]
+    basket_grasp = basket_pre.copy()
+    basket_grasp[2] -= .03
+    move(env.move_to_pose(left, basket_pre))
+    move(env.move_to_pose(left, basket_grasp))
+    move(env.close_gripper(left))
+    move(env.move_by_displacement(left, z=.05))
+    hold(500)
+
+    actions = s.record_stop()
+    print('Generated:', s.status(), 'actions:', actions.shape, flush=True)
+    if not s.status()['success']:
+        raise RuntimeError('The generated trajectory did not complete the task')
+    replay_status = s.replay(actions)
+    print('Open-loop replay:', replay_status, flush=True)
+    if not replay_status['success']:
+        raise RuntimeError('Open-loop replay failed')
+    OUTPUT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    s.save_trajectory(actions, OUTPUT)
+    print('Saved:', OUTPUT, flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    generate()
